result.summary: Found 1 visually broken issue: a stuck loading spinner obscuring a restaurant card image in the Popular right now section.

issues.description: A circular loading spinner in a white circle is stuck in the center of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card image, obscuring the food photo even though the image underneath appears to have loaded.
issues.suggestion: Hide the loading indicator once the image has loaded, use a skeleton placeholder before load instead of overlaying the loaded image, and add a timeout/error state so the spinner does not persist indefinitely.
